messages:
elaine: Quick async — v2 compatibility rollout outline and outstanding owners/questions. Target canary window: Tue Apr 6 09:00 PT. Plan is 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 6h observation blocks. Deprecation target for v1: 2026-05-01. Main asks: who owns the SDK adapter, mobile lib, infra capacity for burst, console rollout dashboard, and telemetry readiness? Also need a fallback policy defined (which model/variant to fall back to).

kai: I can own infra capacity + autoscale policy. Need to confirm dedicated pool sizing. Will run a quick perf smoke Mon and post numbers.

sam: SDK team: we'll cut adapter v2.0.0 candidate tomorrow. PR is https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/443 — it's gated on header parity and a docs snippet for the deprecation warning. I need someone to review the migration guide. @jordan? :eyes:

priya: Mobile: we have an issue with token refresh timing when toggling endpoint host. Mobile lib needs the shim for backward-compat; ETA EOD Wed for the patch. Can we delay 10% canary by 2h if we see auth errors?

jordan: Happy to review the migration guide. Also console: I'll wire a "v2 traffic" chart + per-route latency breakdown. Need sample logs from canary traffic (please tag requests with `x-canary-id`).

marcus: Canary config I'll own. Proposed rollout flags: `canary_percent`, `fallback_model=small-lm`, `auto-rollforward=false`. If errors >1% over 10m, revert to fallback. Quick snippet:```json
{"canary_percent":10,"step_hours":6,"fallback_policy":"model_variant"}```

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Tue Apr 6 08:30-10:00 PT (infra team). If rollout overlaps, we'll hold.

elaine: Notes/action items: 1) kai confirms pool size + perf numbers by Mon 14:00 PT. 2) sam posts PR link + brief migration checklist (docs + example) by EOD Tue. 3) priya finalizes mobile shim Wed EOD. 4) jordan adds `x-canary-id` log requirement and dashboard tile by Tue close. 5) marcus publishes canary config and rollback thresholds 24h before rollout. 6) oncall-bot/ops coordinate hold if maintenance overlaps.

kai: ack — scheduling the perf smoke Mon 10:30 PT. I'll tag infra capacity owners (cc @oncall-bot).

sam: I'll add a short migration checklist in the PR description and ping @elaine for doc sign-off.

priya: Thanks — will also include a small QA matrix (auth, offline, retry). If any critical auth fails during canary we want manual hold, not automatic rollback.

jordan: Adding chart prototype to dashboard — will link here when done.

marcus: Publishing canary YAML to infra repo at `infra/canaries/v2-rollout-2026-04-06.yaml` by tomorrow morning. Will include `rollback_threshold: 1%` and `max_step: 100`.

elaine: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping here and we can escalate to standup. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
